item.title: Wells Fargo and five others object to OKX-ICE tokenized stock listings: Report
item.description: As of Friday, 22 companies had filed objections as part of the joint venture’s proposed tokenized stock platform under the SEC’s innovation exemption.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Turner Wright

item.title: IRS plans lower tax disclosure penalties, including for crypto: Forbes
item.description: The US tax agency is targeting faster resolutions and more flexible payment options for taxpayers voluntarily disclosing past tax violations under a planned program overhaul.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar

item.title: Initia halts blockchain after exploit reportedly drains over $2.6M
item.description: The blockchain suspended its layer-1 network and rollups after security researchers identified unauthorized token minting and millions in assets transferred to Ethereum.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar

item.title: US senator probes Tether after reported deal with ex-Trump crypto adviser
item.description: The Democratic ranking member of the Senate Permanent Subcommittee on Investigations asked Paolo Ardoino for records related to a reported deal between Tether and Nxum.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Turner Wright

item.title: SEC flags tokenization as high-risk area in 2027 market examinations
item.description: The SEC’s latest priorities highlight tokenization as an emerging market risk, while cryptocurrencies remain absent as a standalone examination category.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar

item.title: Bitcoin seeks support above $81K as Brent crude oil hits highest level since March
item.description: Bitcoin dipped below $81,000 as stocks fell and Brent crude hit its highest level since March, leaving the 50-day moving average in focus.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by William Suberg

item.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
item.description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Yohan Yun

item.title: China targets 2030 for its national blockchain network buildout
item.description: China’s five-year digital development plan calls for wider blockchain use in trade and manufacturing alongside stronger technical standards.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Yohan Yun

item.title: New York AG seeks $1.37B from NovaTech founders over Ponzi scheme
item.description: The request follows an August 2025 default judgment, with the AG also announcing nearly $6 million in settlements with four promoters.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai

item.title: Bitcoin consolidates after 3% loss as AI fears stoke fresh stock-market weakness
item.description: Bitcoin price volatility cooled as stock markets battled another day of resurgent AI fears during Friday’s Asia trading session.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by William Suberg

item.title: Was crypto self-custody ever designed for beginners?
item.description: Recent hardware wallet security incidents have renewed debate over whether self-custody is suitable for beginners, as multisig and seedless designs carry their own risks.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Helen Partz

item.title: Cysic dangles a 10% bounty, hacker pours loot into Tornado Cash
item.description: The attacker moved $744,000 in ETH and BNB to Tornado Cash after exploiting Cysic’s bridge to mint 10 million tokens on BNB Smart Chain.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai

item.title: Bybit secures first full Dubai license for spot trading services
item.description: Bybit’s new VARA licence authorizes spot trading services in Dubai, but the exchange must complete additional regulatory requirements before launching.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra

item.title: HSBC launches Hong Kong dollar stablecoin for retail payments
item.description: HSBC is rolling out RedCoin wallets to PayMe users, with plans to support tokenized investment subscriptions and expand into institutional uses.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra

item.title: Malaysia, Thailand join Singapore’s cross-border stablecoin push
item.description: BLOOM seeks to cut costs by helping financial institutions coordinate cross-border use of stablecoins and tokenized deposits.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Yohan Yun

item.title: Bitcoin ETFs bleed $635M as October slides back into the red
item.description: Thursday’s withdrawals ended a three-day inflow streak and left US spot Bitcoin ETFs with $175 million in net outflows for October.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Helen Partz

item.title: Ethereum delays Glamsterdam Hoodi testnet launch over security risks
item.description: ChainSecurity said it identified 13 real-world examples of smart contracts potentially affected by Glamsterdam’s gas changes and is coordinating responsible disclosure with affected projects.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra

item.title: Bitcoin Core changes security policy as AI makes bugs easier to find
item.description: Bitcoin Core says keeping certain vulnerabilities secret no longer offers much protection in the wake of AI-assisted bug hunting.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng

item.title: Switzerland’s first retail spot Bitcoin ETF targets November launch
item.description: BIT Asset Management’s Bitcoin Fund ETF is expected to begin trading on SIX Swiss Exchange in November, with its public offering restricted to Switzerland.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng

item.title: Pentagon bans US forces from using military info to bet in prediction markets
item.description: Hegseth warned that prediction market wagers could expose military operations to adversaries.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng

item.title: New DeepSeek ban in US, Swiss-Asia crypto ties deepen: Asia Express
item.description: DeepSeek banned from US federal civilian agencies over spying fears. Singapore firm behind Europe’s only spot Bitcoin ETF, as Switzerland partners with Vietnam on crypto tech.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Andrew Fenton

item.title: Circle shareholder sues Trump, World Liberty and Steve Witkoff over crypto deals
item.description: According to a Circle shareholder, the US president’s “corruption” through USD1 left the company unable to compete with stablecoins, harming USDC.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Turner Wright

item.title: Dune launches real-time data feeds covering 200 onchain trading venues
item.description: The new service aims to bring onchain trading data into institutional financial systems as tokenized stock markets expand and face growing scrutiny.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar

item.title: Winklevoss PAC moves into Texas Senate race with $81K ad buy
item.description: While crypto-aligned PACs have stepped up spending in Ohio, a committee launched by the co-founders of crypto exchange Gemini made one of its first forays into the Lone Star State.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Turner Wright

item.title: Underdog taps zerohash to bring crypto deposits to prediction markets
item.description: The new funding option, expected to launch later this year, will allow eligible Underdog users to deposit digital assets around the clock.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar

item.title: Bitcoin hashrate hits seven-month high as AI shift fails to ease mining competition
item.description: According to BlocksBridge, Bitcoin’s mining difficulty is rising despite the industry’s AI transition, with smaller operators potentially absorbing equipment abandoned by larger competitors.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Sam Bourgi

item.title: Irish cenbank fines Coinbase arm $3.6M for oversight, safeguard failures
item.description: According to the Central Bank of Ireland, Coinbase Ireland had agreed with the facts around the enforcement action and will be subject to fines and sanctions upon approval by a high court.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Turner Wright

item.title: Bitcoin circles $81.5K ETF cost basis as Trump Iran comments send stocks lower
item.description: Bitcoin extended daily losses to 3% as US stocks came under pressure from President Donald Trump’s comments on Iran military action.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by William Suberg

item.title: Fireblocks disputes report of $2.5B Visa acquisition talks
item.description: Fireblocks told Cointelegraph that reports of a potential $2.5 billion acquisition by Visa are “not true at present time,” while Visa declined to comment on the reported talks.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar

item.title: CryptoQuant CEO calls rising Bitcoin hashrate ‘indirect bullish signal’ from institutions
item.description: Public miners backed by major TradFi players are coming back online, boosting Bitcoin’s hashrate, a positive sign for BTC’s fundamentals, according to CryptoQuant’s Ki Young Ju.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai
